dateAssessment: Working campaign dates use YAML (September 30–November 2, DR 1748). The dated Session 57 (DuFr) timeline places training on October 1–25 and the sacred-water journey on October 26; those dates, used below, are supplementary calendar assignments, not independently spoken dates. The transcript-only YAML assessment remains compatible: one overnight and an approximate three-and-a-half-week montage do not establish the exact November 2 closing boundary. Its proposed final week is still future play. The arrival watch below follows t01's predawn/sunrise reading; the dated record's afternoon label remains a flagged discrepancy. watches.summary: Kenzo lands at sunrise; two minutes pass checking wounds.
Hour-long river walk after the dawn arrival; watch estimated across dawn/morning.
Whole-day walk ends at evening; first-night feast and evening conversation follow.
The village council meets the morning after Kenzo's first night.
About three and a half weeks of language and village-life training; no watch is established.
Elazar wakes Kenzo just past midnight; a few hours' walk ends before dawn.
Kenzo experiences days of study inside the journey; this does not add adventure days.
Kenzo awakens at sunrise after three or four hours at most outside the journey.
